name: reel-chat
title: Chat thread
description: WhatsApp-style chat on the stage: messages arrive one by one, typing dots before each reply (reel-05 beat 1)

CHIP.description: The pill title at the top of the stage, e.g. "STEP 1"

CHIP_SMALL.description: Smaller text after it, e.g. "· Kapso"

MESSAGES.description: [{"from": "in"|"out", "text": "...", "time": "2:04", "buttons": ["11:00 AM", "4:00 PM"], "pick": 1}, ...] in order; a reply gets typing dots first, "pick" taps a button

BG.description: "bg" draws the navy stage panel over the top half; "none" leaves it clear

MESSAGES.text: Haan ji! Friday ke free slots 👇
